channel.title: AI Frontier Post
channel.description: Dispatches from the AI frontier: AI news, research explainers, frontier lab coverage, and product comparisons.

item.title: Kill every system ad on your Android phone — no root: hands-on with android-ad-cleaner
item.dc:creator: Sofia Almeida
item.description: android-ad-cleaner (rddmwmddr/android-ad-cleaner, MIT, 6,745 GitHub stars) strips system ads, hot search, and marketing push notifications from Xiaomi, OPPO, vivo, Honor, and Huawei phones — no root, fully reversible. This guide runs it end to end: adb setup, a backup snapshot, the per-model recipe, and notification-channel cleanup.

item.title: Google acquires Crusoe's Wyoming AI data center site a day after $17 billion campus announcement
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Crusoe said on November 6, 2026 that Google has acquired its data center site in southeast Wyoming, completing the AI infrastructure firm's pre-development work on the campus a day after Google announced a $17 billion investment in its first Wyoming data center.

item.title: Codex CLI 0.167.0: an agent command center that flags unread results, no daemon required
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: OpenAI shipped Codex CLI 0.167.0 on November 6, 2026: an agent command center you can open without a daemon, unread-result markers, backend switching that keeps your drafts, local image previews, and a Google Cloud Vertex AI setup wizard.

item.title: Cursor Voice Chat with Agents: talk to your coding agent in real time, powered by Grok Voice
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Cursor shipped Voice Chat with Agents on November 6, 2026 — realtime voice calls with your coding agent, powered by Grok Voice, in the Agents Window, the IDE, on the web, and on iOS.

item.title: sand3d: write 3D models in Python that your LLM can actually generate — hands-on
item.dc:creator: Sofia Almeida
item.description: sand3d (Sandflow-ai/sand3d, Apache-2.0, 721 GitHub stars) is a Python library for writing 3D objects as short programs over Blender's bpy — built so an LLM can generate a whole part in a few hundred tokens. This guide installs it, builds a bracket, articulates a washing machine, and hands the API to a model.

item.title: Salesforce Koa Decisions: a Gemma-based decision model that answers in milliseconds
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Salesforce introduced Koa Decisions on November 6, 2026 — the next version of its HyperClassifier routing model, built on Google’s open-weight Gemma, that reads text, images, and audio and returns a decision in a single step, in milliseconds.

item.title: Wizstar Wizshot 1.0 turns up to 9 reference images into 720p video at 5 credits a second
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Wizstar launched Wizshot 1.0, its first in-house reference-to-video model: 720p clips of 5 to 15 seconds from up to nine reference images, at 5 credits per second — 72% cheaper than Seedance 2.0, the company says.

item.title: Physicl Studio generates synthetic training data for physical AI robots — $10M seed
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Paris startup Physicl raised $10M led by Inovia Capital and launched Studio, an app that generates synthetic training data from 10,000 3D environments and 100,000 assets for the rare edge cases where robots and world models fail.

item.title: Ro Research Lab: the telehealth firm turning millions of patient journeys into AI medical discovery
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Telehealth firm Ro launched Ro Research Lab on November 6, 2026, pairing AI with real-world data from millions of patient journeys to speed medical discovery — and it plans to share what it finds, including with drugmakers.

item.title: ZCode 3.17: build a website and deploy it in one click — hands-on
item.dc:creator: Sofia Almeida
item.description: ZCode 3.17.2 (zai-org/ZCode, Apache-2.0, 8,518 GitHub stars) adds the official ZCode Sites plugin for one-click website deployment, plus Kimi K3.1 Pro and MiniMax M3.1 Flash model options. This hands-on sequel installs the desktop app, builds a small site with the agent, and publishes it.

item.title: Embodied AI AIR humanoid robot learns factory jobs by watching human operators
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Swiss startup Embodied AI unveiled AIR on November 6, 2026, a wheeled humanoid robot built to share the factory floor with people. It learns each job from a human operator's demonstrations — typically within a month — and its tendon-driven arms give way on contact. The robot was built in nine months and is already being tested with global manufacturers.

item.title: CYBERSHIELD AI: Wizard Cyber's agentic SOC platform reaches a verdict in 3.5 minutes — humans still sign off
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Wizard Cyber launched CYBERSHIELD AI on November 6, 2026, an agentic AI platform for security operations in which specialised agents triage and investigate alerts — reaching an evidenced verdict in 3 minutes 30 seconds on average — while a senior analyst signs off every decision.

item.title: DSH Go: run DeepSeek Harness on your Android phone — hands-on
item.dc:creator: Sofia Almeida
item.description: DSH Go (ccch1mneyyy/dsh-go, AGPL-3.0, 11,983 GitHub stars) puts DeepSeek Harness on your Android phone: an on-device Ubuntu runtime runs the agent with no root and no Termux, or it drives the DSH on your computer over SSH. This guide installs the v1.0.11 APK, wires up a model, runs a first task, and connects a remote host.

item.title: Cainiao opens its warehouses to train embodied AI robots
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Cainiao, Alibaba's logistics arm, opened its global warehouse network to AI and robotics partners on November 6, 2026, offering live logistics operations as a training ground for embodied AI — and a “Global Tech in Three Days” service to ship robots and AI hardware around the world.

item.title: Kakao Kanana-2-v-decide: a 3.67B decision model that answers in probabilities, not prose
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Kakao released Kanana-2-v-decide, a 3.67B multimodal model that answers typed questions with probabilities instead of generating text — averaging under 0.04 seconds per decision on a single H200 GPU, with weights on Hugging Face under a commercial-use license.

item.title: Serve Robotics Physical AI Services: the delivery-robot maker wants to be the AWS for robots
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Serve Robotics is opening the connectivity, data-curation and training-data stack behind its 2,000-robot delivery fleet to other robot makers. Bedrock Robotics is the first customer — and CEO Ali Kashani calls it the company's AWS moment.

item.title: Shield AI buys Echodyne for $5.3B — and raises $2.5B at a $28.8B valuation
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Shield AI has agreed to acquire counter-drone radar maker Echodyne in a $5.3 billion deal, and is raising $2.5 billion — including a $1 billion Series H at a $28.8 billion valuation — to pay for it.

item.title: METR: Anthropic's AI progress doubled in a year — and AI did most of the work
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: METR's independent assessment, published November 5, 2026, finds Anthropic is improving its models about twice as fast as before, with benchmark scores growing 1.9 times their old rate — and says AI itself likely accounts for most of the acceleration, though Anthropic redacted much of the evidence.

item.title: Inkling 2 Small: Thinking Machines' 594B model ships on Tinker, with open weights next week
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Thinking Machines Lab introduced Inkling 2 Small on November 5, 2026: a 594-billion-parameter mixture-of-experts model with 17 billion active parameters, scoring 31 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index. It runs on Tinker now; full weights follow under Apache 2.0 next week, pending safety testing.

item.title: Cicada: live subtitles and AI meeting notes for any call — hands-on
item.dc:creator: Sofia Almeida
item.description: Cicada (wquguru/cicada) turns any Zoom call, Teams meeting, or YouTube livestream into live bilingual subtitles and structured AI meeting notes by listening to your system audio — no bot joins the call, and on Apple silicon the speech recognition never leaves your Mac. This guide installs v1.3.0, captions a real meeting, wires OpenRouter in for live notes, and speaks back in the other side's language.

item.title: Kimi Hosted Agents: Moonshot AI turns the agent harness into a managed cloud service
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Moonshot AI formally launched Kimi Hosted Agents on November 5, 2026: a managed cloud service that runs AI agents for enterprises and developers — the harness, as a hosted product — with sandbox time from ¥0.072 an hour.

item.title: Perplexity Teammates: persistent AI agents that own your ongoing work, for $200 a month
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Perplexity launched Teammates on November 5, 2026: persistent AI agents built on Computer that own ongoing work — planning projects, monitoring changes, and escalating for approval — available now to Max subscribers on the web for $200 a month.

item.title: Claude Personal Finance: Anthropic lets Claude read your bank accounts — but not move a dollar
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Anthropic launched Personal Finance in Claude on November 5, 2026: a US beta that connects bank and card accounts through Plaid so Claude can answer money questions from real balances and transactions — read-only, with no ability to move, manage or invest your money.

item.title: Wealthsimple Penny: an AI assistant that moves money and places trades — with your sign-off on every move
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Wealthsimple unveiled Penny, an AI assistant that can move money, place trades and manage everyday finances — but never acts without client confirmation.

item.title: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash: Google's AI video model now makes 15-second clips for $0.07 a second
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Google made Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash generally available on November 5, 2026: native 15-second video generation and editing, multi-turn conversational edits, and a 30% price cut to $0.07 per second for 720p video.
